title: Your core speaks ledgers.
The new core speaks blockchains.
lead: Every bank and fintech runs on a core, the system of record that holds accounts, moves money, enforces rules, and survives audits. Those systems were designed in the 70s and 80s, and their architecture remains the same.

rows.new: Instruction and settlement collapse into one atomic event.
Break queues and confirmation matching become system properties.
Capital that waited two days can move the same afternoon.
Launching a payout flow doesn't require an 18-month change request.
